name: 19096 · Wynnewood, PA
findings: ZIP 19096 (Wynnewood) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19096 (Wynnewood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
